description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Address points identify unique house numbers inside addressed building footprints where possible, with mail stops distinguishing multi-unit structures and mobile-home parks. Fields include address identifier, parcel number, jurisdiction and status. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for hazard exposure studies. Some vacant parcels have temporary addresses. These are address locations, not a building-footprint, occupancy or floor-area dataset. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
